cases.title: Strip Authorization header on cross-origin redirect when port changes
cases.issue_body:
When following a 302 redirect from `https://api.example.com:8443/v1/items` to `https://api.example.com:9443/v1/items`, `httpx.Client` preserves the `Authorization` header even though the origin port changed.

Screenshot of captured proxy headers showing leaked bearer token:
![proxy-header-leak](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3112/httpx-redirect-port-leak.png)

Traceback / repro:
```
client = httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True)
resp = client.get('https://api.example.com:8443/v1/items', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer secret'})
assert 'Authorization' not in resp.request.headers  # AssertionError
```
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/client/test_redirects.py b/tests/client/test_redirects.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/tests/client/test_redirects.py
+++ b/tests/client/test_redirects.py
@@ -210,6 +210,16 @@ def test_cross_domain_redirect_strips_auth():
     assert 'authorization' not in response.request.headers
 
 
+def test_cross_port_redirect_strips_authorization_header():
+    transport = MockTransport(cross_port_redirect_handler)
+    with httpx.Client(transport=transport, follow_redirects=True) as client:
+        response = client.get(
+            'https://example.com:8443/protected',
+            headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer top-secret'},
+        )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert 'authorization' not in response.request.headers
+

cases.title: model_validate_json fails on nested discriminated union with alias_generator
cases.issue_body:
Using `alias_generator=to_camel` with a nested discriminated `Union` raises `ValidationError: Unable to extract tag using discriminator` during `model_validate_json`, whereas Python `model_validate` succeeds.

Schema inspector screenshot comparing JSON vs Python paths:
![pydantic-union-alias](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9481a1b2-c3d4-4e5f-8901-abcdef123456)

Crash log:
```
pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for Envelope
payload
  Unable to extract tag using discriminator 'event_type' [type=union_tag_not_found]
```
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_discriminated_union.py b/tests/test_discriminated_union.py
index 3333333..4444444 100644
--- a/tests/test_discriminated_union.py
+++ b/tests/test_discriminated_union.py
@@ -412,6 +412,18 @@ def test_discriminated_union_basic():
     assert isinstance(m.pet, Cat)
 
 
+def test_discriminated_union_with_camel_alias_json():
+    raw = '{"payload": {"eventType": "click", "targetId": 7}}'
+    env = Envelope.model_validate_json(raw)
+    assert env.payload.event_type == 'click'
+    assert env.payload.target_id == 7
+

cases.title: Yield dependency cleanup skipped when StreamingResponse disconnects early
cases.issue_body:
When a client aborts an SSE `StreamingResponse`, the `finally:` block of a `Depends(get_db)` generator dependency is not awaited until garbage collection, leaking DB connections under load.

Flamegraph showing leaked SQLAlchemy session pool slots:
![fastapi-yield-leak](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11205/fastapi-streaming-pool-leak.png)
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_dependency_yield_streaming.py b/tests/test_dependency_yield_streaming.py
index 5555555..6666666 100644
--- a/tests/test_dependency_yield_streaming.py
+++ b/tests/test_dependency_yield_streaming.py
@@ -18,6 +18,16 @@ def test_streaming_dependency_normal():
     assert events == ['enter', 'exit']
 
 
+def test_streaming_dependency_cleanup_on_early_disconnect():
+    state = {'closed': False}
+    with TestClient(build_streaming_app(state)) as client:
+        with client.stream('GET', '/events') as resp:
+            next(resp.iter_lines())
+    assert state['closed'] is True
+

cases.title: z.coerce.date() returns Invalid Date instead of ZodError on empty string
cases.issue_body: Calling `z.coerce.date().safeParse('')` coerces empty string to `new Date('')` (`Invalid Date`) and fails to surface a consistent `invalid_date` error code when paired with `.optional()`.

cases.title: RegExpRouter drops wildcard middleware when mounted on sub-app with trailing slash
cases.issue_body: When mounting `app.route('/api/', subApp)` and registering `subApp.use('*', authMiddleware)`, requests to `/api/users` bypass `authMiddleware` under `RegExpRouter` while working under `TrieRouter`.

cases.title: AsyncClient leaks HTTP/2 stream semaphore when response body iteration raises CancelledError
cases.issue_body:
Cancelling an `async for chunk in response.aiter_bytes()` task leaves the HTTP/2 stream slot occupied until connection timeout, causing subsequent requests to stall.

Trace recording of stalled event loop:
![httpx-h2-stall](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3240f012-3456-4789-abcd-ef0123456789)
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/client/test_async_client.py b/tests/client/test_async_client.py
index 1010101..2020202 100644
--- a/tests/client/test_async_client.py
+++ b/tests/client/test_async_client.py
@@ -145,6 +145,15 @@ async def test_stream_response():
     assert body == b'hello'
 
 
+async def test_stream_cancellation_closes_underlying_stream():
+    closed = False
+    stream = TrackedByteStream(on_close=lambda: nonlocal_close())
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=StreamTransport(stream)) as client:
+        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
+            await cancel_mid_stream(client)
+    assert stream.is_closed
+

cases.title: URL.copy_merge_params drops repeated query keys with empty values
cases.issue_body: Merging query parameters with `url.copy_merge_params({'flag': ''})` strips existing duplicate keys like `?tag=a&tag=b` instead of preserving multi-value query ordering.

diff --git a/tests/models/test_url.py b/tests/models/test_url.py
index 1212121..2323232 100644
--- a/tests/models/test_url.py
+++ b/tests/models/test_url.py
@@ -310,6 +310,11 @@ def test_url_copy_merge_params():
     assert str(url) == 'https://example.com/?a=1&b=2'

+    url = httpx.URL('https://example.com/?tag=a&tag=b')
+    merged = url.copy_merge_params({'flag': ''})
+    assert str(merged) == 'https://example.com/?tag=a&tag=b&flag='
+

cases.title: JSON Schema generation enters infinite recursion on mutually recursive Generic models
cases.issue_body:
Defining `Node[T]` referencing `Edge[T]` referencing `Node[T]` triggers `RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded` inside `GenerateJsonSchema.generate_definitions`.

Call-graph cycle diagram:
![recursive-generic-cycle](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9812/pydantic-generic-cycle.png)

Stack trace excerpt:
```
  File 'pydantic/json_schema.py', line 512, in generate_inner
  File 'pydantic/json_schema.py', line 1188, in definition_ref_schema
RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded
```
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_json_schema.py b/tests/test_json_schema.py
index 3434343..4545454 100644
--- a/tests/test_json_schema.py
+++ b/tests/test_json_schema.py
@@ -920,6 +920,16 @@ def test_recursive_model_json_schema():
     assert '$defs' in schema
 
 
+def test_mutually_recursive_generic_models_json_schema():
+    class Edge(BaseModel, Generic[T]):
+        target: 'Node[T]'
+    class Node(BaseModel, Generic[T]):
+        value: T
+        edges: list[Edge[T]] = []
+    schema = Node[int].model_json_schema()
+    assert '$defs' in schema
+    assert any('Edge' in k for k in schema['$defs'])
+

cases.title: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) drops computed_field when field_serializer is attached
cases.issue_body: A `@computed_field` paired with `@field_serializer` is omitted when `model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` is called, even though computed fields should always be serialized unless explicitly excluded.
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_computed_fields.py b/tests/test_computed_fields.py
index 5656565..6767676 100644
--- a/tests/test_computed_fields.py
+++ b/tests/test_computed_fields.py
@@ -240,6 +240,14 @@ def test_computed_field_basic():
     assert m.model_dump() == {'x': 2, 'double': 4}
 
 
+def test_computed_field_with_serializer_preserved_on_exclude_unset():
+    class Item(BaseModel):
+        price: int = 10
+        @computed_field
+        @property
+        def label(self) -> str:
+            return f'${self.price}'
+    assert Item().model_dump(exclude_unset=True) == {'label': '$10'}
+

cases.title: Session.merge_environment_settings ignores NO_PROXY CIDR ranges for IPv6 hosts
cases.issue_body:
Requests to `http://[fd00::1]:8080/health` still route through `HTTP_PROXY` even when `NO_PROXY=fd00::/8` is configured in the environment.

Packet capture diagram showing unexpected proxy CONNECT:
![requests-ipv6-noproxy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6612/requests-ipv6-cidr-proxy.png)
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_utils.py b/tests/test_utils.py
index 3c3c3c3..4d4d4d4 100644
--- a/tests/test_utils.py
+++ b/tests/test_utils.py
@@ -645,6 +645,11 @@ def test_should_bypass_proxies_ipv4_cidr():
     assert should_bypass_proxies('http://10.0.0.5/', no_proxy='10.0.0.0/8')
 
 
+def test_should_bypass_proxies_ipv6_cidr():
+    assert should_bypass_proxies('http://[fd00::1]:8080/health', no_proxy='fd00::/8')

cases.title: CliRunner mixes ANSI color escape sequences into stderr when mix_stderr=False
cases.issue_body:
Invoking a Click command via `CliRunner(mix_stderr=False)` under `FORCE_COLOR=1` strips ANSI codes on `stdout` differently from `stderr`, breaking snapshot tests.

Terminal screenshot showing mangled ANSI sequences:
![click-ansi-stderr](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2685/click-stderr-ansi.png)
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_testing.py b/tests/test_testing.py
index 7a7a7a7..8b8b8b8 100644
--- a/tests/test_testing.py
+++ b/tests/test_testing.py
@@ -185,6 +185,14 @@ def test_runner_separate_stderr():
     assert result.stderr == 'err\n'
 
 
+def test_runner_preserves_ansi_consistently_on_stderr_when_color_true():
+    @click.command()
+    def cmd():
+        click.secho('boom', fg='red', err=True)
+    runner = CliRunner(mix_stderr=False)
+    res = runner.invoke(cmd, color=True)
+    assert '\x1b[31mboom\x1b[0m' in res.stderr
+

cases.title: Option(multiple=True, default=()) raises TypeError when envvar supplies comma-separated values
cases.issue_body: Defining `@click.option('--tag', multiple=True, default=(), envvar='APP_TAGS')` crashes with `TypeError: can only concatenate tuple (not 'list') to tuple` when `APP_TAGS=alpha,beta` is set.
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_options.py b/tests/test_options.py
index 9c9c9c9..adadada 100644
--- a/tests/test_options.py
+++ b/tests/test_options.py
@@ -520,6 +520,14 @@ def test_multiple_option_envvar():
     assert result.output == 'a,b\n'
 
 
+def test_multiple_option_envvar_with_empty_tuple_default(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @click.option('--tag', multiple=True, default=(), envvar='APP_TAGS')
+    def cli(tag):
+        click.echo(','.join(tag))
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, env={'APP_TAGS': 'alpha beta'})
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    assert result.output == 'alpha,beta\n'
+

cases.title: Response.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True) splits multi-byte UTF-8 characters across chunk boundaries
cases.issue_body:
Streaming responses with `chunk_size=16` raise `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte` when a 4-byte emoji spans two network chunks.

Hex dump screenshot of split UTF-8 boundary:
![requests-utf8-chunk](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6801aaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeffff0000)
cases.ground_truth_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_requests.py b/tests/test_requests.py
index 5858585..6969696 100644
--- a/tests/test_requests.py
+++ b/tests/test_requests.py
@@ -1540,6 +1540,12 @@ def test_iter_lines_unicode():
     assert list(resp.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True)) == ['hello', 'world']
 
 
+def test_iter_lines_decode_unicode_handles_split_multibyte_utf8():
+    payload = ('hello 🚀 world\nline2\n').encode('utf-8')
+    resp = make_chunked_response(payload, chunk_size=7)
+    lines = list(resp.iter_lines(chunk_size=7, decode_unicode=True))
+    assert lines == ['hello 🚀 world', 'line2']
+
